verdict.rationale: Elastic's own materials say its 'nightshift AI SRE' detects and investigates incidents and delivers an evidence-backed root cause, which directly matches the story. The docs also mention surfacing correlations and root causes, plus natural-language interaction with telemetry. The evidence is only short marketing and overview claims, so how deep the investigation goes is not shown. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the AI investigates a specific alert or error and presents its root-cause hypothesis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
This includes zero-config anomaly detection, pattern analysis, and the ability to surface correlations and root causes.
Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
